b: The French composer was famed for his work on Serge Gainsbourg's Histoire de Melody Nelson
Jean-Claude Vannier, the widely respected French composer and arranger whose work lit up Serge Gainsbourg's 1971 concept album Histoire de Melody Nelson, has died at the age of 83.

He passed away in Paris earlier today (27 November), Libération reports. "Jean-Claude Vannier was a singular, unclassifiable, profoundly independent artist whose creativity and audacity transcended generations ," said Virginie Vannier, one of his daughters, in a message sent to AFP.

Vannier's daughter's tribute continued: "His work has inspired international artists such as Beck and Mike Patton, and his compositions have been sampled by artists like Eminem and Massive Attack, testifying to the modernity and timeless appeal of his work."
